headline: Binance Restores Full Customer Withdrawals Following October Hack
summary: Binance announced that customer withdrawals have been fully restored, four weeks after a $6.3 billion hack.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges. Security incidents and withdrawal suspensions significantly impact trader liquidity and market confidence.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Restored withdrawals at a major exchange affect overall crypto market liquidity and sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The full restoration of customer withdrawals alleviates major liquidity concerns and market panic stemming from the October hack.
